node.statement: For c,d in U(1), bilinearity gives (cU) bold-dot(dV)=(cd)(U bold-dot V). Scalar preservation of calU from node 1.1 and global domain membership from lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws put both U bold-dot V and (cU) bold-dot(dV) in S_delta. Applying lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality with scalar cd yields mu(cU,dV)=u_delta((cd)(U bold-dot V))=cd*u_delta(U bold-dot V)=c*d*mu(U,V).
